+position_column: todo

+title: Decision slot real-model integration test with Mapika decider-2b on Metal
+---
+## What
+Source: ../FoundationModelsDecision/plan.md decision D14 and section 13 step 2. Unit tests use stub containers only; this is the one real-model test, in the nested package `IntegrationTests/`.
+
+- `IntegrationTests/Package.swift`: add the `FoundationModelsDecision` product to the integration test target if the test needs its types.
+- New `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterIntegrationTests/DecisionSlotIntegrationTests.swift`, gated like `GGUFProfileIntegrationTests.swift` (same suite trait and model-cache handling):
+  1. Resolve a GGUF profile (reuse the standard/flash GGUF models of `GGUFProfileIntegrationTests.swift`) with `decision: ["Mapika/decider-2b-GGUF/decider-2b-v12-Q4_K_M.gguf"]`. Check `profile.decision.chosen` is the decider ref, the format is `DeciderPromptFormat` (its `decider_config.json` came through the metadata source), and 3 to 5 items of `../FoundationModelsDecision/Tests/FoundationModelsDecisionTests/Fixtures/decider-metal-reference.json` (one yes/no, one choice, one score; copy the items into the test) give the reference top answer, with probabilities within 0.005 of the reference.
+  2. Resolve the same profile with `decision: []`. Check `profile.decision.chosen == profile.flash.chosen`, the format is `GenericPromptFormat`, and a clear yes/no question gives the expected answer.
+  3. One decision while a flash generation runs on the same model (fallback case) finishes, and the generation finishes (the llama.cpp lock serializes them).
+- Do not add a time limit to any test (see the memory note on test time limits).
+- Add the new test to the integration command list in `docs/testing.md`.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] The three tests pass on this Mac (Apple silicon, Metal) with `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests --filter DecisionSlotIntegrationTests` and the test count is not 0 (see the memory note on `--filter` false passes).
+- [ ] The CI Integration job runs the new tests (check that its filter or test list includes them).
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `IntegrationTests/Tests/FoundationModelsRouterIntegrationTests/DecisionSlotIntegrationTests.swift` as above.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --package-path IntegrationTests --filter DecisionSlotIntegrationTests` once and read the count of tests that ran.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #decision
\ No newline at end of file
